pacing_light.meta_title: Real-time Pacing Light System · WAVELIGHT SYSTEM
pacing_light.meta_desc: Wavelight LED pacing system visually guides every athlete on the track to their target pace.
pacing_light.hero_desc: The Wavelight LED pacing system features LED lights installed along the inside rail of the track that illuminate sequentially at a set pace, providing an intuitive and immersive race experience for both athletes and spectators alike.
pacing_light.wavelight_title: What is the Wave Light System?
pacing_light.wavelight_desc: Wave Light consists of LED modules installed along the inside rail of the track. Each LED lights up sequentially matching the target record, appearing as if light is running along the track.
pacing_light.wavelight_desc2: Officially adopted at major international events including the World Athletics Diamond League, PACE RISE brings this technology to Korean tracks.
pacing_light.principle_1: Set target records by distance (800m, 1500m, 5000m, etc.) and the system automatically calculates the speed per lap.
pacing_light.principle_2: LED modules along the inside rail light up sequentially at the calculated speed, providing visual pacing for athletes.
pacing_light.principle_3: Multiple paces — world records, event records, personal goals — can be displayed simultaneously using different colors.
pacing_light.feature_visual_pace_desc: Athletes can instantly identify their position relative to the target record, directly contributing to race strategy.
pacing_light.feature_all_events_desc: Flexibly set and operate pacing for all track events, from middle-distance to long-distance.
pacing_light.feature_spectator_desc: LED light movement visually conveys race tension, maximizing spectator immersion.
pacing_light.feature_performance_desc: As a visual pacemaker, it helps athletes maintain consistent lap times, increasing the chance of record-breaking.
pacing_light.usecase_diamond_league_desc: Precision pacing for world record attempts and maximizing elite performance.
pacing_light.usecase_national_desc: Technical operations for major national championships including KTFL events.
pacing_light.usecase_youth_desc: Naturally teaching young athletes goal-awareness and race strategy.
pacing_light.usecase_masters_desc: Providing amateur runners with pro-level pacing experience.
pacing_light.usecase_training_desc: Used by coaches and athletes for precise pace control during training.

cos.meta_title: COS · Competition Operating System · PACE RISE : Node
cos.meta_desc: From tournament creation to finals — all competition operations in one system. 182 REST APIs, 47 real-time events, built-in WA rule engine.
cos.hero_desc:
From tournament creation to finals advancement — every track & field competition workflow unified in a single platform.

Real-time record entry, automatic Q/q qualification, official document output, electronic scoreboard integration, and live broadcast overlay — all seamlessly connected.
cos.operator_desc: Systematically manage all workflows needed for competition operations.
cos.op_workflow_desc: Tournament creation → Event setup → Athlete registration → Heat assignment → Record entry → Round progression → Finals. Supports automatic Q/q ranking and WA seeding rules.
cos.op_record_entry_desc: Track: time + wind, LIF file import. Field: distance & wind, fouls/pass, WA tie-break rules. High jump: O/X/– input with auto-elimination after 3 failures. Mixed event scoring, relay team/leg management.
cos.op_callroom_desc: Barcode check-in, live attendance monitoring, per-athlete/event notes, admin post-event access.
cos.op_documents_desc: Start List PDF, Result Sheet PDF (DNF/DQ/Q/q), comprehensive record Excel/PDF, AD Card PDF, customizable templates (logo, signatures, field selection).
cos.op_scoreboard_desc: LIF file import with event key-mapping for electronic scoreboard integration. Software-only operation without additional hardware.
cos.op_broadcast_desc: OBS scoreboard overlay, lower-third captions, and broadcast graphics via WebSocket in real-time. No separate graphics software needed.
cos.consumer_desc: Access live competition results from anywhere — no page refresh required.
cos.con_realtime_sse_desc: SSE + WebSocket-based real-time record updates without page refresh. Pop-up dashboards per event for instant detailed information.
cos.con_open_page_desc: Authentication-free open.html page with federation filtering for quick record lookup.
cos.con_overlay_desc: Connect scoreboard overlay and lower-third captions directly to OBS. Real-time data via WebSocket enables broadcasting without separate graphics equipment.
cos.con_result_image_desc: Auto-generated high-resolution result images (1080×1350 PNG) and Excel downloads. Optimized for social media sharing.
cos.arch_backend_desc: Single-server deployment based on better-sqlite3. Quick setup and stable operation without complex infrastructure.
cos.arch_frontend_desc: Lightweight, fast-loading pure JavaScript SPA without frameworks. PWA support for app-like mobile experience.
cos.arch_realtime_desc: Separate SSE broadcast for streaming and WebSocket for scoreboards. Optimized real-time communication per channel.
cos.arch_security_desc: Viewer (operation_key), Judge/Staff (record entry), Admin (full control, bcrypt, post-event lock). Rate Limiting + Helmet security, audit/operation logs, DB backup/restore.
cos.wa_rules_desc: Wind limits, tie-breaks, high jump failure counting, Q/q auto-qualification, mixed event scoring — World Athletics (WA) rules are built into the software to prevent operator errors and ensure fair competition.
cos.custom_desc: Every competition has its own unique operational environment. PACE RISE : Node flexibly adapts to event-specific requirements beyond standard workflows.
cos.custom_event: Event-specific customization: event structure, round formats, record calculation criteria
cos.custom_special: Optimized settings for special environments (unofficial events, multi-sport meets, school championships)
cos.custom_meeting: Pre-event meetings to understand operational scenarios and deliver tailored solutions
cos.custom_quote: Whatever the event, we'll discuss first and build the optimal environment for you.
